title: The amount of willpower it took to walk out of there without adopting...
transcript: One of the coolest things that I got to do while in Gander was visit the real life Bonnie at the Gander SPCAa. Now, if you've never seen come from away, Bonnie was the one who took care of all of the animals that were trapped in the cargo holds of the airplanes that were stranded there. Most famously, a rare bonobo chimpanzee named Unga, who is represented on a wall of Come From Away alum. And there's even a painting from her child hanging up in Bonnie's office, the child, of course, being named Gander. Now, this is actually a brand new facility that they are still working on finishing, and they are taking donations if you feel inclined to help out. But they've already started housing a ton of animals, including a lot of cats. This one had a whole litter of tiny kittens, which was so cute. A rabbit and an office dog. And while obviously it was so cool to meet all of the animals, the coolest part was just getting to talk to Bonnie herself and getting to hear her perspective of what it was like caring for all those animals. She said she never once really considered that it could be dangerous. Her only focus was on helping those animals. And now she gets to continue that mission with the Gander SPCAa, which has grown so much since it was founded and continues to help so many Animals
